Dialogs.Dialog: A friend of mine was saying his girlfriend is too clingy and it's a pain.
Anegasaki
...A pain, huh... I guess you'd hate being tied down too, right？
Well, if it's too extreme...
I thought so. ...Maybe I should be careful about that too.
I don't think you're like that, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
That's good, then... But you know, I get how his girlfriend feels.
Eh？
Girls are full of anxiety every single day. Like, if he didn't call, or didn't text...
Hmm... Alright! Then I'll be more attentive to you too, ●.
Hehe, thank you. But don't push yourself too hard, okay？
Getting anxious and worrying is part of the thrill of romance. It makes it feel like we're really dating, right？
(Hmm, which is it...)
Anegasaki
What do you think it means to date someone？
Where'd that come from？
It's not out of nowhere. It's my current research topic. Have you never thought about it？
Hmm, not really.
Then I'll change the question. What's the difference between a girlfriend and a friend？
Well, a girlfriend is someone you're dating, and the rest are friends. So... what is it？
See, now you can't help but think about it, can you？ Hehe, think hard and give me an answer.
...？ For ●, the only difference is between ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ and everyone else...
Huh!? Jeez, that's not fair.
Scared of what？
That was a perfect score♪
(Yes! But what does dating actually mean in the end...)
Anegasaki
Ah, there's a stain on your shirt.
Where... Oh, you're right. Must be from eating.
This might be tough to get out. Ah, to think I was right here and missed it.
Yeah, from now on, I'll do your laundry for you.
It's fine. I'd feel bad making you do that!
Why would you feel bad？ We're dating, so it's only natural, right？
It's natural？
Yeah. Or are you embarrassed to have me see your laundry？
Wait, so even my underwear!?
Of course I did.
(...Dating is a pretty big deal, huh.)
You look sleepy, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Are you okay？
Anegasaki
...Sorry. I couldn't fall asleep last night, so I'm a bit sleep-deprived.
What's wrong？ Worried about something？
Yes...
If you're okay with ●, tell me.
Thank you. But... I can't remember.
Wait, remember what？
...What I was worried about. No, I'm not joking, I was really worried enough to lose sleep over it. But then, one thing after another kept popping into my head.
Like what shoes I wore when I saw you last, or how I threw away a magazine without checking my horoscope... And then, I forgot what I was worried about in the first place...

Um, so does that mean you
don't have any worries？

No, my current worry is
that I can't remember it.
(Girls sure have it tough...)

▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, are you in a better
mood than usual？
Anegasaki

Am I？ I feel normal.
Aren't you having fun with me？

Of course I am.
I'm having fun too, ●.

Good.
Hehe, but today is actually
special. I finally sorted
out something on my mind.

Oh？ What were you
thinking about？

No way. You're too naive if
you think you can learn
a girl's secrets that easily.

Is that how it is...
Guess I'll let it go.

Wait, you're just giving up？
Shouldn't you be a little
more persistent？
(What am I supposed to do...)

It's so easy to tell what
boys are thinking.
Huh!
Anegasaki
Cake buffet...
What about a cake buffet？

Huh!
How did you know!?

What do you mean？
You just said it out loud.
Oh no. I said it out loud...

...Well, I'm on a diet, but
my friend invited me to a
cake buffet. I'm so torn.
Haha, why don't you just go？

Don't say it like it's easy!
It's a huge deal for girls...
Ugh... I really shouldn't!
I see, then you should just—

You're right, holding back
isn't good. I'm gonna go.

(That's your takeaway？
...I really don't get girls.)
Anegasaki

Hey... there's something I
want to ask you. Is that okay？
No, I won't.

Um, when was the time your
heart pounded the most？

Pounded？ Hmm, probably when
you confessed to me, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Huh.
Even thinking about it now—

Ah, stop.
If you say any more, my
heart will start pounding...

Haha...
But why did you want to know？

Well, I heard it's important
to always keep your boyfriend's
heart racing. But it seems
mine is the one racing now.
You're so cute, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...
Geez...

When does your heart pound,
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Anegasaki

Why the sudden question？
You're scheming something,
aren't you？
I'm just curious.
Hmm.

...Right now.
Just this very moment.
Huh？ Right now？
Right before I kiss you.
Wait, does that mean...？ Could it be...
Just kidding. Well, who knows？
(Oh man, my heart's pounding now.)
Anegasaki
Hey, I was interviewed for the school paper.
The one they put up on the bulletin board？
Yeah. They asked me to answer as a rep for the 3rd-year girls.
Oh, what was it about？
"When Girls' Hearts Race: A Feature on Girls' True Feelings!"
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s true feelings, huh. I can't wait to read it!
Hehe, it's not a feature on me. It's on girls.
Huh？ ...But you answered as the representative for the girls, right, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Yeah, but I'm anonymous and there's no photo. Ah...
No! You absolutely can't look at it. Promise me.
(I'm worried...)
Anegasaki
Hey, can I ask you something？ Do you prefer excitement or comfort？
Hmm, I guess for ●, it's comfort... at least for now. What about you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Same here. I want to feel calm and peaceful.
But I think I'd rather make my girlfriend's heart race than my own.
I see... There are lots of ways to make a heart race. Like fear, or surprise... or even embarrassment.
● wants to see your embarrassed side, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
You're imagining something weird, aren't you？ No way.
(...Okaay.)
Anegasaki
Hey, are you keeping any secrets from me？
Eh！？
Hmm, so you are...
No, no! I'm not.
Really？ Well, I guess that's fine.
What's with the sudden question？
Hehe, curious？ A girl in my class taught me how to spot a boyfriend's lies. I just wanted to test it...
Hehe, why did you freeze up？ It's okay, everyone has secrets. But lying is a no-no.
Hey. Won't you teach that method to ● too？
Too bad. This is a method for spotting a boyfriend's lies.
(That's not fair...)
Anegasaki
Hey, do me a favor. Look into my eyes.
Huh？ Okay. ...▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Can you see your reflection in my eyes？
Yeah, I can.
Mhm... Let me introduce you. He's the person I love the most.
Hehe, isn't that a lovely confession？ It's my favorite scene.
From a movie or something？ My heart skipped a beat.
Yay! It worked. It's a really cute way to confess, isn't it？
Yeah, I guess so. ...But ● likes the confession from ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ better.
...Jeez, that's not fair, saying that out of nowhere. ...Now you've got my heart pounding.
Anegasaki
Hey, I've got some happy news for you...
What kind of news？
Well, lately, customers have been seeing me as my actual age.
Oh, really？ If ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is happy, then ● is happy too.
Hehe, thanks. But if I've changed, I think it's your fault. Because we're always together.
You think so...? Then, does ● look any different to other people？
Yeah, you've gotten more reliable. ...Ah, I get it.
Hm？ What is it？
Hehe, nothing. I just figured it out. I'm looking my age, and you're looking more reliable... See what I mean？
Come to think of it, haven't I been scheduled on different shifts from ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...？
Anegasaki
Oh, are you just now noticing that？ So slow. I was so curious about it, I even asked the manager.
Oh, really. So, what did he say？
Yeah. It turns out he's intentionally scheduling us separately on some days.
Why？ Does he think we're slacking off together or something？ We don't chat while working.
Actually, it's the opposite. Rather than working with me, he wants you to take charge of the floor when I'm not there. He may not look it, but he really watches his staff.
Is that so... He doesn't look it. But if we're separated, there's no point working at the same place...
Honestly, it's your fault. You've gotten too good at your job. How are you going to make it up to me？
What! Even if you say that...
...Just kidding. I already talked to the manager, so it's fine. He said he'll put us on the same shift when possible.
I see, that's good.
Anegasaki
You've been working really hard at your part-time job lately, haven't you？
You think so？ But I still can't hold a candle to ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Why not？ Not just me, but everyone at the restaurant really values you.
I'm glad to hear that, but... Getting customers to like and remember me like they do ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲... I feel like hard work alone isn't enough.
Hehe, thanks. But haven't you noticed？ There are girls who come to the restaurant just to see you.
Huh？ Girls？
Hey! Don't get all excited about that. You know, the girl who comes with her mom on weekend evenings.
You mean the one with the elementary school backpack...
Hehe, you're so easy to read. But maybe I should be a little worried. She might be quite a catch in the future.
Eh？
Anegasaki
Sorry things got so awkward when we bumped into each other in the hallway the other day.
...Oh, when ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s friends were teasing us. I don't mind.
...I'm glad.
Besides, it goes both ways, right？ When ● is with friends and runs into ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, it gets just as awkward.
Yeah, it even makes things awkward between us.
Yeah, I always feel like everyone is staring at us.
Maybe everyone is wondering what we're like when it's just the two of us...
Ah, talking about it just makes me even more self-conscious.
(...Now ● is feeling self-conscious too.)
There are always so many people around ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, huh.
Anegasaki
I knew it？ You feel like it's increased a lot lately, right？ I found out why. Wanna know？
Yeah, what is it？
I met a girl recently, and according to her, I'm a success story.
Of what？
Do you know that Friday 9pm drama, 'A Year Younger'？
I think I've heard my friends talking about it...
I haven't seen it either, but it's just like the title. Everyone admires that couple. So, they're interested in us.
...Do you get asked a lot of things about ●？
Don't look so worried... It's fine. I just talk about our usual selves.
(What on earth is she saying？)
Anegasaki
Hey, did you notice？
Scared of what？
Don't you think we've had a lot of alone time in the break room at work lately？
...Now that you mention it, maybe？
Right？ Hehe, I actually overheard the other girls talking the other day.
They timed the restocking and trash duty so we could take our breaks together.
Oh, that's kinda nice. A little embarrassing, though.
But that's not all... They've been talking about us to the regulars, too.
What！
What if it spreads from the customers to all of Towano City...
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ seems to be enjoying it, though...)
Anegasaki
Hey, a friend invited me to the amusement park the other day.
Oh, nice. Are you going？
Yeah, but... they said you should come, too.
●, too？
Yeah, a double date, I guess？ What do you think？
A double date... Maybe it's good to see other couples once in a while.
What's wrong？
You know, she said the same thing. That it's good to see other couples. That means we'll be observing each other, right.
Showing our usual selves... takes some courage.
If ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ feels that way, let's pass. We can invite them when we feel up to it.
Yeah, thanks. I might be fine with just the two of us forever, honestly.
Anegasaki
Looks like they hired a new part-timer.
Oh, a newbie is coming.
... Why are you so excited？ You're hoping it's a cute girl, aren't you？
Gender doesn't matter. It's just like when a transfer student comes.
Hmm. She's a cute girl.
Hmm...
But, too bad for you. She's dating someone at our shop.
I said it's not too bad！ ...So, who is she dating？
Rumor has it... the manager—
What！！
Just kidding, it seems to be a guy from the kitchen.
Ah, you scared me！
Hehe, as the senior couple at Dexy's, I can't help but be a little curious.
Anegasaki
Hey, do guys ever get curious about other couples？
Hmm, ● doesn't really... Why do you ask？
Girls just can't help it. When we see a close couple, we think 'I won't lose!'.
You compete with them？
Hehe, yeah. If we stare too much and make eye contact, we just nod at each other for no reason. It's funny.
Haha, so that's what you do. ● only has eyes for ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, so I had no idea.
Ah, no fair. You're always playing the good boy.
Because I am a good boy!
Yes, yes. Then I'll give the good boy some pats.
Hey, wait, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...
Oh, I thought you didn't care about the people around us？ Come closer, or I can't give you your pats. Hehe.▼
(...I'm absolutely sure we aren't losing to anyone.)
Anegasaki
When you're together a long time, you get to experience all sorts of things.
Hmm, yeah. We've already done so many things together.
True, but there are still things we can't easily do. ...Like breakfast.
Breakfast？
Yeah. I can make you lunch, and we can eat dinner together, but... breakfast is a bit difficult, right？
I wonder if we'll be able to eat it together every day sometime...
We will! ...Probably.
Yeah, you're right. We will. Thank you.
Anegasaki
The other day, my classmates called us a veteran couple.
You mean us, ●？ ...Have we really been together that long？
Well, one of them said their longest relationship was only a month.
Hmm, I guess that makes sense.
And, you know, talking about long or short relationships suddenly made me scared. Because that implies there's an end, right？
Now that you mention it, yeah.
I can't even imagine that, but what about you？
Of course ● can't either. I'd be fine with forever.
Right, 'til death do us part？
Haha, exactly. In sickness and in health—
As long as we both shall live. ... We'll save the rest for later.
(For later, huh...)
Anegasaki
I've been thinking lately. When did being with you become so natural？
It's hard to say exactly when.
When we first met, we were awkward and couldn't express our feelings well... We went through a lot, didn't we？
Yeah.
Looking back, that frustrating feeling wasn't so bad either.
I think ● prefers how things are now, though.
No, I prefer how things are now too. But don't you think our past selves were cute？ It makes you want to cheer them on.
True. If the past us, ●, hadn't tried our best, we wouldn't have the present.
Ah, I bet there's a sci-fi movie like that. Like our far-future selves are cheering us on right now.
The far-future ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, huh... I wonder what you'll...
Hey, don't go imagining anything weird.
